evidence.snippet: Dwight: Apparently there is a famous Hollywood movie from the 1980's, Beautiful Girl…

beats.summary: Pam reveals she has been the Office Administrator for months but has not been paid due to lost paperwork.

evidence.snippet: Pam: A few months ago. I was talking to someone at corporate, who isn't there anymore, and I think the paperwork just got lost in the shuffle.
Pam: And, I haven't gotten paid yet. I'm not blaming you.

beats.summary: Jim and others help Dwight transform into a gentleman with new clothes and social advice.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Before me stands your coworker, Dwight Kurt Schrute. Dwight, show them all sides.
Andy: If someone offers you a cocktail, accept, but keep your wits about you.

beats.summary: Michael shares bizarre stories about being raised by wolves and being probed by an alien, which Toby dismisses as fake.

evidence.snippet: Toby: Come on Michael. Those are all fake stories.

beats.summary: Toby suggests passing time by playing games and drawing pictures after their counseling session stalls.
